description: This Java class, GroupingTypesDataValidator, is a final component responsible for validating various group-related data operations within the Fineract project. It provides validation methods for creating, updating, activating, and closing group and center entities, as well as assigning staff and managing client associations. The class leverages helper classes for JSON parsing and validation, and enforces data integrity and business rules before processing.

classes.name: GroupingTypesDataValidator
classes.description: A final Spring component class responsible for validating various group-related data operations in the Fineract platform, ensuring data integrity before further processing.

methods.name: validateForCreateCenter
methods.description: Validates the JSON command for creating a new center, checking required fields, lengths, and logical consistency.

methods.name: validateForCreateCenterGroup
methods.description: Validates the JSON command for creating a new group within a center, including field validation.

methods.name: validateForCreateGroup
methods.description: Validates data for creating a generic group entity, verifying fields like name, external ID, office, staff, and date fields.

methods.name: validateForUpdateCenter
methods.description: Validates update operations for a center, including validation of date relationships and optional fields.

methods.name: validateForUpdateGroup
methods.description: Validates update operations for a group, with similar checks as creation, including date validation.

methods.name: validateForActivation
methods.description: Checks that the activation date parameter in the JSON command is valid and present.

methods.name: validateForUnassignStaff
methods.description: Validates the JSON input for unassigning staff from a group, ensuring staffId is provided and valid.

methods.name: validateForAssignStaff
methods.description: Validates JSON input for assigning a staff member to a group, including optional inheritance flag.

methods.name: validateForAssociateClients
methods.description: Validates the JSON payload for associating clients with a group, ensuring client member list is present.

methods.name: validateForDisassociateClients
methods.description: Validates payload for removing client associations from a group, ensuring client list is provided.

methods.name: validateForCenterClose
methods.description: Validates the data required for closing a center, including closure date and reason.

methods.name: validateForGroupClose
methods.description: Validates the data for closing a group, including closure date and reason.

methods.name: validateForAssociateGroups
methods.description: Validates the JSON for associating multiple groups, checking group member list.

methods.name: validateForDisassociateGroups
methods.description: Validates the payload for disassociating groups, verifying group list.
